modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: IBEX flies small aircraft, so a bag within the cabin limits may still be taken at the gate and carried in the hold.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 carry-on bag, total of three sides within 100cm (45cm x 35cm x 20cm), including handles and wheels. Applies to travel on or after 19 May 2026.
carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: Translated from IBEX's Japanese baggage page; rules for travel on or after 19 May 2026 (the page keeps separate, older rules for travel up to 18 May 2026).

carryon_weight.value: Personal item and carry-on bag together must weigh 10kg or less.
carryon_weight.notes: Translated from IBEX's Japanese baggage page; rules for travel on or after 19 May 2026 (the page keeps separate, older rules for travel up to 18 May 2026).

personal_item.value: A personal item is allowed in addition to the carry-on bag, within the combined 10kg limit.
personal_item.notes: Translated from IBEX's Japanese baggage page; rules for travel on or after 19 May 2026 (the page keeps separate, older rules for travel up to 18 May 2026).

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Rules for travel on or after 19 May 2026.

free_allowance.value: Up to 2 bags free, each up to 23kg. More bags can be checked for an excess baggage charge, up to 20 per person.
free_allowance.notes: Translated from IBEX's Japanese baggage page; rules for travel on or after 19 May 2026 (the page keeps separate, older rules for travel up to 18 May 2026).

size_weight.value: Free bags: total of three sides within 158cm (and within 75cm high and 105cm wide). For an excess charge, bags up to 45kg each, 100kg in total and 292cm total dimensions can be accepted; bags over 292cm or over 45kg each are not accepted.
size_weight.notes: Translated from IBEX's Japanese baggage page; rules for travel on or after 19 May 2026 (the page keeps separate, older rules for travel up to 18 May 2026).

free_items.value: Mobility and medical aids used by the passenger, folding strollers, portable cribs and child seats are checked free of charge.
free_items.notes: Translated from IBEX's Japanese baggage page; rules for travel on or after 19 May 2026 (the page keeps separate, older rules for travel up to 18 May 2026).

online_checkin.value: Online check-in is available from 24 hours until 20 minutes before departure.

bag_drop_cutoff.value: Check your bags at least 20 minutes before departure; after that you may not be able to board.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
